say:1:1041551001:1.text: Ahh, the Emberlight Festival is the best!
say:1:1041551001:1.source_cn: 春焰庆啊，真是个不错的节日……

say:2:1041551002:1.text: Everywhere you look, it's just lights and fireworks. All those bright colors stir up poetry in my heart!
say:2:1041551002:1.source_cn: 到处都是灯光与焰火，缤纷的色彩让诗意涌上心头——

say:3:1041551003:1.text: Oh? I seem to recall someone, a little kid mind you, complaining about how loud it was outside, saying they couldn't even hear themselves sing.
say:3:1041551003:1.source_cn: 噢？我怎么记得有些人小时候曾经抱怨过，外面太吵，唱歌都...

say:4:1041551004:1.text: You were so upset no one could hear your performance, you nearly cried...
say:4:1041551004:1.source_cn: 最后差点因为别人没能听到自己的表演而哭鼻子……

say:5:1041551005:1.text: T-that was ages ago! I'm all grown up now, I'm not the type to be all show-offy anymore!
say:5:1041551005:1.source_cn: 那、那是很久以前啦，婆婆！我都这么大了，早就不是爱出风...

say:6:1041551006:1.text: Hahaha, oh my dear, getting older makes us all a bit sentimental.
say:6:1041551006:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，上岁数了就是喜欢回忆过往。

say:7:1041551007:1.text: In the blink of an eye, you've grown into a fine young man! You've been off on your adventures every year; it's so rare for you to come home.
say:7:1041551007:1.source_cn: 转眼间，你也长成大小伙子了，年年在外，难得回来一趟。

say:8:1041551008:1.text: But this year's different, isn't it? It's not just you; everyone's said they'll come back to gather.
say:8:1041551008:1.source_cn: 不过今年春焰庆倒是不一样了，不仅是你，好像大家都说过要...

say:9:1041551009:1.text: Really?! Well then, leave it to me, Grandma! I'll round everyone up, and we won't miss your Emberlight feast for anything!
say:9:1041551009:1.source_cn: 是吗？那就交给我吧！婆婆！我去把他们叫来，绝不会错过您...

say:10:1041551010:1.text: I'll even set off a big firework just for you!
say:10:1041551010:1.source_cn: 到时候我给您放个大烟花！

say:11:1041551011:1.text: *Sigh* This child... still can't grow out of wanting to be the center of attention...
say:11:1041551011:1.source_cn: 真是，这孩子根本还是一样爱出风头嘛……
